headline: Oil Rose 1.1 Percent to $94.77 as Silver Fell 1.12 Percent
narrative: Crude oil rose 1.1 percent to $94.77, a bid in the energy pipe. Silver fell 1.12 percent to $59.47 and gold eased 0.11 percent to $4,185.90, so precious metals moved the other way. Copper rose 0.47 percent to $6.73, a small industrial bid that tracked oil rather than silver.
author: jordan
